pattern.name: sprint_planning
pattern.description: Standard sprint planning flow from backlog to committed sprint.

steps.step: Call `scrum_get_backlog` with optional search or labels filter
Review top items against DoR checklist
Call `scrum_get_sprint` to check current sprint capacity
Call `scrum_plan_sprint` with selected stories and sprint goal

example.agent_flow: 1. Orient: `scrum_orient` 2. Load backlog: `scrum_get_backlog` 3. Check DoR: review each candidate 4. Plan: `scrum_plan_sprint` with stories [A, B, C] and goal "Implement authentication flow" 5. Template: `scrum_get_template` sprint_planning

pattern.name: impediment_logging
pattern.description: Record a blocker on a specific story.

steps.step: Call `scrum_log_impediment` with description and affected story reference

example.user_request: Log a blocker on story #42 — the API endpoint is down.

pattern.name: backlog_refinement
pattern.description: Refine backlog items by adding acceptance criteria, estimates, or labels.

steps.step: Call `scrum_update_story` to add acceptance criteria or estimates
Call `scrum_add_vocabulary` if new labels are needed

pattern.name: burndown_analysis
pattern.description: Analyze sprint progress using burndown data.

steps.step: Compare actual vs. expected burn rate
Flag carry-over risk if remaining days < remaining points
Compute average velocity from the returned data
